name: m223-aftoba
prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16 photoreal, 7th-century Arabia, bright clear morning in a courtyard. Exactly three hands in the frame. From the bottom left: the two hands of ONE elderly man, held together and cupped, palms up - thin, wrinkled, aged skin with visible veins - both from the same person, one plain undyed sleeve pair. From the top right: one younger anonymous RIGHT hand holding by its handle a tall hand-hammered copper ewer for ablution (an aftoba / ibriq) with a long slender curved spout; the ewer is about as tall as a forearm, correctly scaled to the hands. A thin clear stream of water flows from the tip of the long spout into the old man's cupped palms and drips down into a small shallow copper basin below, the basin no wider than the ewer is tall. Each hand has exactly five fingers, natural proportions. No faces, no heads, no other people or hands. Background softly blurred: a whitewashed mud-brick wall and green date palms. Even daylight, vibrant warm colours, gentle and caring, no modern objects.
